title: Fuel price cap re-imposed for October 2026 — government regulation 172/2026 Sb. sets a daily maximum petrol and diesel price at every public filling station
money_note: No money is attached to the need. The regulation caps a price; its own explanatory memorandum says no direct budget or business impact can be quantified in advance, so nothing is scored.
summary: Government regulation 172/2026 Sb. of 21 September 2026 caps the retail price of 95-octane petrol and B7 diesel at every publicly accessible filling station from 1 to 31 October 2026, using a daily formula of the average wholesale or Rotterdam-based price plus a 2.50 CZK/l regulated margin plus 21 % VAT, published each working day by the finance ministry. It is the fourth cap of 2026 (after May, June and early July), re-imposed after the 10 and 18 September oil-supply shocks and issued together with a partial diesel excise waiver.
notes: STATUS: ENACTED — nařízení vlády č. 172/2026 Sb. ze dne 21. září 2026 (e-Sbírka ELI versions 2026-09-25 promulgated / 2026-10-01 in force; read from the ELI open-data endpoint, text fragments saved as pages/esbirka/sb-2026-172.txt). DATES: § 3(1) in force 1 Oct 2026; § 3(2) expires at the end of 31 Oct 2026. WHO MUST ACT: every seller at a publicly accessible filling station, for 95-octane E5/E10 petrol and B7 diesel (or the cheapest additive grade where the plain grade is not usually sold, § 1); each working day's maximum = arithmetic mean of (a) the three largest wholesalers' offer prices (Unipetrol Index Czech, MOLIN, ČEPRO base prices) over the current and two previous working days and (b) Platts Barges FOB Rotterdam High + 92 USD/t (petrol) or CIF NWE High + 90 USD/t (diesel) over the previous three working days, plus 2.50 CZK/l margin, plus 21 %; the finance ministry publishes it in the Cenový věstník for the next day (§ 2(4)); enforcement by the Specializovaný finanční úřad. WHY (explanatory memorandum, VeKLEP KORNDY5KT835, saved as pages/veklep/zd_KORNDY6KW2UP.txt): the 10 Sep 2026 attack on the East-West pipeline to Yanbu and Saudi Aramco's 18 Sep 2026 notice of non-delivery under long-term contracts; retail prices track Brent with a one-week lag (correlation above 0.91 since 2022); Q1 2026 daily price reporting failed because indicative margins showed individual extreme values, especially on motorways and near borders; earlier caps: finance-ministry výměr 1/2026 from 2 Apr 2026, then NV 65/2026 (20-31 May), 79/2026 (June), 120/2026 (1-19 July), ended 20 Jul 2026. KNOCK-ON: the labour ministry's travel-allowance decree draft (VeKLEP KORNDXWQDTHG, zd saved) records that the August 2026 average price of 95-octane petrol reached 41.80 CZK/l, 20.46 % above the 2026 decree value, which triggers an extraordinary revision of reimbursement rates from 1 Oct 2026 for every employer. DEDUP: the corpus holds the earlier caps only as VeKLEP metadata cards (veklep-KORNDU3AQW1C, veklep-KORNDUEE4451, veklep-KORNDVHE5272) and the enabling act card veklep-KORNDT4CKC7A; the October draft card veklep-KORNDY5KT835 is being surfaced by this week's scripted veklep run. This record is the enacted Sbírka instrument with its formula and dates. Searched the corpus for: pohonných hmot, fuel price, cenový výměr, price cap.

title: Minimum wage 2027 published — MPSV notice 171/2026 Sb. sets 24,900 CZK a month and 148.30 CZK an hour from 1 January 2027
money_note: No aggregate wage-bill figure is published; the notice fixes rates, not a budget attached to the need, so nothing is scored.
summary: The labour ministry's notice 171/2026 Sb. of 23 September 2026 publishes the 2027 minimum wage at 24,900 CZK a month and 148.30 CZK an hour for a 40-hour week, the lowest guaranteed-pay levels by work group, and a hardship-environment allowance range of 1,245 to 3,735 CZK a month. Every employer must pay at least these amounts from 1 January 2027, and payroll systems and pay tariffs have to be reset before the first January pay run.
notes: STATUS: ENACTED — sdělení Ministerstva práce a sociálních věcí č. 171/2026 Sb. ze dne 23. září 2026 o vyhlášení minimální mzdy, nejnižších úrovní zaručeného platu a rozpětí výše příplatku za práci ve ztíženém pracovním prostředí pro rok 2027 (e-Sbírka ELI 2026/171, text read from the open-data fragments, saved as pages/esbirka/sb-2026-171.txt). Legal bases cited: § 111(7)(b), § 112(4) and § 128(3) of Act 262/2006 Sb. (zákoník práce) as amended by Act 230/2024 Sb. DATES: applies to wages for 2027, i.e. from 1 Jan 2027. FIGURES: monthly minimum 24,900 CZK, hourly 148.30 CZK (40-hour week); lowest guaranteed pay, work group 1 = 148.30 CZK/h and 24,900 CZK/month (higher groups in the notice's table); hardship allowance 1,245-3,735 CZK/month. DEDUP / WHAT IS NEW: reg-min-mzda-koeficient-2027-2028 recorded the proposal and reg-min-mzda-2027-164-2026 recorded the enacted coefficient 0.446 and the computed 24,809.64 CZK before rounding; this record is the published crown amount after the labour code's rounding, plus the guaranteed-pay table and the allowance range, which neither earlier record carries. Knock-on: OSVČ and state-payer health-insurance minimums and thresholds keyed to the minimum wage move with it.

title: AIFMD II in Czech law — Act 130/2026 Sb. gives fund managers until 1 March 2027 and open-ended funds until 16 April 2027 to comply
money_note: The act attaches no budget; the duty is a compliance change for fund managers and administrators, so nothing is scored.
summary: Act 130/2026 Sb. of 8 July 2026 amends Act 240/2013 Sb. on investment companies and funds to transpose Directive (EU) 2024/927 (AIFMD II / UCITS), in force 1 September 2026 with a set of points taking effect on 16 April 2027. Fund managers and fund administrators must bring their funds' statutes, key information and operations into line within six months (by 1 March 2027), open-ended fund managers must adopt the new liquidity-management rules by 16 April 2027, and loan-originating funds get grandfathering until 16 April 2029.
notes: STATUS: ENACTED — zákon č. 130/2026 Sb. ze dne 8. července 2026, kterým se mění zákon č. 240/2013 Sb., o investičních společnostech a investičních fondech (e-Sbírka ELI versions 2026-07-23, 2026-09-01, 2027-04-16; prefix, Čl. II transitional provisions and Čl. VIII effect clause saved as pages/esbirka/sb-2026-130-excerpt.txt). DATES: Čl. VIII — in force on the first day of the second calendar month after promulgation (1 Sep 2026), except Art. I points 107, 108, 110, 112-115 and 160-162, in force 16 Apr 2027. Čl. II point 1: managers bring funds, statutes and key information documents into line with §§ 20b, 20c, 21a(3)-(4), 26a, 29(4), 30(2), 33(1)(a), 83(1), 220(1)(i),(m), 241 and 456(1) within 6 months of effect (= 1 Mar 2027); point 10: administrators the same for §§ 47b, 50(2), 53a, 231, 456(2); point 2: open-ended fund managers comply with § 37b(1)-(2) and § 465(1) by 16 Apr 2027; points 3-9: loan-originating special funds and qualified-investor funds created before 15 Apr 2024 are deemed compliant with §§ 37c, 37j, 37k until 16 Apr 2029, with leverage and single-borrower exposure frozen where above the new limits. WHO: Czech investment companies, self-managed funds, qualified-investor funds (FKI) and their administrators, supervised by the ČNB. CARRIED DEBT CLEARED: named as unrecorded by the 2026-09-18, 2026-09-19 and 2026-09-21 reg-scan passes. DEDUP: the corpus has no AIFMD II record (searched: AIFMD, 2024/927, 130/2026, 240/2013).

title: EHDS patient and clinician identification for MyHealth@EU — Impl. Reg. (EU) 2026/2099 applies from 26 March 2027
money_note: The implementing regulation attaches no budget; it sets identification requirements, so nothing is scored.
summary: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2099 sets how patients, health professionals and healthcare providers are identified and authenticated before personal health data is exchanged across borders through MyHealth@EU: providers must identify the patient and, for online requests, authenticate them with eIDAS means of at least substantial assurance, and professionals must be authenticated at substantial level by a body each Member State designates. It applies from 26 March 2027; from 26 March 2029 providers must accept healthcare attributes presented from a European Digital Identity Wallet, and assurance level high becomes mandatory for patients in 2030 and professionals in 2032.
notes: STATUS: ENACTED — Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2099 of 21 September 2026, published in OJ L on 22 September 2026 (CELLAR enumeration pages/eu/ojL-pub-2026-09-22_28.csv), in force on the twentieth day after publication; text read via CELEX content negotiation (pages/eu/32026R2099-en.txt). DATES: Art 9 — applies from 26 Mar 2027; Art 3(3) (issuing healthcare attributes to a person's EUDI Wallet) and Art 5(2) (providers must accept wallet attestations) apply from 26 Mar 2029; Art 3(2) Member States notify their national set of healthcare attributes by 26 Mar 2028; Art 4(2) patient eID assurance 'high' from 26 Mar 2030; Art 6(3) professional authentication 'high' from 26 Mar 2032. WHO: every health professional and healthcare provider that requests a cross-border exchange via MyHealth@EU (Art 4, 5), the entity each Member State lists to identify, authenticate and authorise professionals (Art 6), and national contact points for digital health (Art 5(1), 7). Czech angle: the Czech entity for Art 6 has to be designated and professionals need notified eID at substantial level; the Czech national set of healthcare attributes (Art 3) does not yet exist. DEDUP: reg-ehds (Reg. (EU) 2025/327) and reg-ehds-metadata-drzitele-dat-2029 (Impl. Reg. 2026/2098) are the parent act and the secondary-use sibling; the MyHealth@EU platform act 2026/2083 was deliberately not recorded on 2026-09-21 as state infrastructure. This act differs because it lays duties on providers and professionals. Searched: 2026/2099, MyHealth@EU, healthcare attributes, European Digital Identity Wallet.
quote: following a natural person’s request submitted online, that health professional or healthcare provider shall identify and authenticate that natural person using electronic identification means issued in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 910/2014.

title: Omnibus I enacted — Directive (EU) 2026/470 cuts CSRD to firms over 1,000 staff and EUR 450m turnover; Czech transposition due 19 March 2027
money_note: The directive attaches no budget; it narrows reporting and due-diligence duties, so nothing is scored.
summary: Directive (EU) 2026/470 of 24 February 2026 amends the Accounting, Audit, CSRD and CSDDD directives so that sustainability reporting applies only to undertakings with more than 1,000 employees and over EUR 450 million net turnover, from financial years starting on or after 1 January 2027, and shields value-chain suppliers under 1,000 employees from information demands beyond the voluntary standard. Member States must transpose the reporting changes by 19 March 2027 and the due-diligence changes by 26 July 2028, so the Czech accounting and audit acts must be amended within six months.
notes: STATUS: ENACTED — Directive (EU) 2026/470 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 24 February 2026, OJ L 26.2.2026, in force on the twentieth day after publication (Art 6); text read via CELEX content negotiation (pages/eu/32026L0470-en.txt). DATES: Art 5(1) — transposition of Arts 1-3 (audit, accounting and CSRD directives) by 19 Mar 2027; Art 4 (CSDDD) by 26 Jul 2028; the new scope applies to financial years starting on or after 1 Jan 2027, and the first wave's obligations under Art 5(2)(a) of Directive 2022/2464 are limited to three financial years from 1 Jan 2024. SCOPE: net turnover above EUR 450,000,000 and more than 1,000 employees on average; third-country threshold raised from EUR 150m to EUR 450m; 'protected undertakings' with up to 1,000 employees may answer value-chain requests by self-declaration. CARRIED DEBT CLEARED: named as gap 8 by the 2026-09-21 reg-scan pass. STALE FACT IT CORRECTS: reg-csrd-post-omnibus (2026-08) still says 'Final Omnibus I text pending formal adoption — treat scope/dates as agreed but not yet in OJ'; this is the adopted text. Companions already in the corpus: reg-esrs-value-chain-cap-2027 (Del. Reg. 2026/1560) and reg-esrs-revize-2027 (Del. Reg. 2026/1563), both of which cite this directive. title: Business loans to sole traders — Finance Ministry bill targets predatory lending to OSVČ, effective January 2028
money_note: No money is attached to the need. The RIA cites about 60bn CZK of outstanding principal on loans to sole traders (ČNB ARAD, July 2026) as the market's size, which is not a budget and is not scored.
summary: A Finance Ministry bill in comment procedure would extend consumer-style protection to self-employed people who borrow for their business, restricting acceleration of the whole debt on short arrears and notarial deeds with consent to enforcement, the tools its RIA names in predatory lending to sole traders and in consumer loans disguised as business loans. The RIA puts outstanding loans to sole traders at about 60bn CZK and the population at up to two million entrepreneurs, and the proposed effective date is January 2028.
notes: STATUS: DRAFT — MF bill 'Návrh zákona, kterým se mění některé zákony v oblasti sjednávání úvěrů pro podnikatele a zákon č. 358/1992 Sb., o notářích' (VeKLEP KORNDY9BQZVI, '2 - v připomínkovém řízení', authorised 25 Sep 2026, comments due 26 Oct 2026); nothing in it is in force. DATE: the RIA summary gives 'Předpokládaný termín nabytí účinnosti: 1/2028'. DEFINICE PROBLÉMU (RIA saved as pages/veklep/ria_KORNDY9BQZVI.txt): non-consumer borrowers who are natural persons, typically OSVČ, fall under only the general civil-code loan rules, a regulatory arbitrage against the strict consumer-credit act (ZSÚ 257/2016) that enables predatory practice: lending to uncreditworthy sole traders at high rates with non-standard amortisation, acceleration after a few days' arrears and a notarial deed with consent to enforcement as the enforcement title; plus fictitious 'business' loans on an IČO that are really consumer loans. Worked case from the Institut prevence a řešení předlužení: 460,000 CZK contracted, 300,000 CZK paid out (160,000 CZK broker commission), 1.7 % a month, no principal repayment for 10 years, acceleration after 3 days' arrears, accelerated 27 Sep 2023 and enforced 3 Oct 2023 for 1,402,800 CZK. Scale: 1,996,027 natural-person entrepreneurs holding 3,079,454 trade licences (MPO, Q2 2026), about 1.2 million OSVČ in social insurance (MPSV), about 60bn CZK outstanding principal to sole traders (ČNB ARAD 1053, July 2026). Options assessed: C.1 acceleration (zesplatnění), C.2 notarial deeds. Consulted: ČBA, ČLFA, APNÚ, HK ČR, AMSP, IPŘP, Člověk v tísni and others. DEDUP: nothing in the corpus on business lending to sole traders (searched: úvěry pro podnikatele, nespotřebitel, predátor, na IČO, notářský zápis); the VeKLEP metadata card for this material is being surfaced by this week's scripted run.
quote: Z údajů ČNB (databáze ARAD, sestava č. 1053) pak vyplývá, že k červenci 2026 dosahovala dlužná jistina z úvěrů poskytnutých živnostníkům výše cca 60 mld. Kč.
